title: Open-Booking Limits for Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Clause

Booked visits of a Specimen Collection Appointments patient are counted across all of the patient's visit types, as the patient's visit records currently show them. A patient may hold at most **3** booked visits at one time across all orders and visit types. For one order there may be at most the visit type's published number of booked visits at a time (one, for every visit type), except a standing order, whose future draws may be booked up to the visit type's published standing-series figure at once. A new booking that would exceed a cap is refused until an existing booked visit is collected, cancelled or recorded as a no-show. Rescheduling an existing visit is not a new booking and is not counted again.

The count rests on the system record: the status of each of the patient's visits as the visit records show it, matched to the patient. A "booked" visit is one whose status is booked — not yet checked in.

## Caps in one view

| What is counted | Cap |
|---|---|
| Booked visits of the patient, all orders and visit types together | 3 |
| Booked visits for one order | The visit type's published per-order figure |
| Booked future draws of one standing order | The visit type's published standing-series figure |

## Cases (hypothetical patients)

| Patient's current booked visits | Requested action | Outcome under the clause |
|---|---|---|
| 2 booked visits, on different orders | A new booking on a third order | Within the cap of 3 — not refused by this clause |
| 3 booked visits | A new booking | Exceeds the cap of 3 — refused until one of the booked visits is collected, cancelled or recorded as a no-show |
| 3 booked visits | Moving one of them to another date | Not a new booking; not counted again |
| 1 booked visit for an order that is not a standing order | A second booking for the same order | Exceeds the per-order cap of one booked visit |

## Basis Q&A

**Does a visit that is checked in still count?** No. Only visits whose status is booked are counted; once a visit is checked in, collected, cancelled or recorded as a no-show it no longer counts as booked.

**Does the cap of 3 change with the visit type?** No. It applies across all orders and visit types together.
